{{Top|leg}}
'''CMC-3''' was a mining outpost in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] that was at one time ran by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Mining Corporation]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it had been long abandoned and the [[Liana Liberators]] traveled there in the space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Perihelion]]'', to hide out there while they planned to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into important computer systems in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. While there, they reactivated some of the facility's systems, including the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and a large cutting beam. They used these to attack the ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' and [[Shiana Trist]]'s [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] when they arrived in the facility to try and capture the Liberators.
